regression.note: First audit for this client. No prior onsite-audit.json existed, so regression detection was skipped.

manual_findings.title: LocalBusiness schema publishes a Fair Lawn address while every audited page targets Kenilworth
manual_findings.detail: JSON-LD LocalBusiness on all 6 pages sets streetAddress '8 Harlow Crescent, Fair Lawn, NJ 07410' and sameAs google.com/maps?cid=5612453956771500683 (the Fair Lawn GBP). The client record nap block says '500 S 31st St, Kenilworth, NJ 07033' and gbp.google_cid 8008820373441604497 (the Kenilworth GBP). Page titles, H1s and meta descriptions all target Kenilworth. Structured data and on-page targeting therefore point at two different locations.
manual_findings.source: manual verification of rendered JSON-LD, not a DataForSEO check id

manual_findings.title: Site publishes (908) 970-8533 site-wide, not the (855) 650-7422 GBP line named in the client record
manual_findings.detail: All 6 pages render tel:+19089708533 (5 tel links on /contact/ alone) and schema telephone +19089708533. The client record onboarding_notes.phone_discipline states 'ONE phone everywhere: GBP line (855) 650-7422'. Verify which number is intended before citation building.
manual_findings.source: manual verification of rendered HTML and JSON-LD, not a DataForSEO check id

manual_findings.title: schema sameAs still points at pre-rebrand Elite Restoration Group social profiles
manual_findings.detail: sameAs lists facebook.com/EliteRestorationGroups and instagram.com/eliterestorationgroup. The client record lists post-rebrand social URLs as still awaiting intake, so this is expected but should close out.
manual_findings.source: manual verification of rendered JSON-LD, not a DataForSEO check id

verified_non_issues.note: DataForSEO reports has_micromarkup=false on all 6 pages. Manually verified that valid JSON-LD IS present on every page (LocalBusiness, Organization, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList). The check only detects microdata/RDFa, so this is a detection artifact and NOT a missing-schema finding.
'(555) 555-5555' appears once on /contact/ as the phone input's placeholder attribute. This is intended form UX, not a leaked placeholder number.

environment_caveats: Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (formFactor=desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). The DataForSEO MCP wrapper does not expose form_factor. Mobile performance would typically score 10-20 points lower.

Scores and Core Web Vitals in this file come from the full_data Lighthouse run (lighthouse 13.4.0). A first reduced-response run minutes earlier produced values within normal run-to-run variance (home performance 98 vs 99, home LCP 902 ms vs 860 ms).
Audited the apex production origin with no x-robots-tag noindex present, so the SEO category counts toward every verdict. The staging noindex correction did not apply.
